kata.name: Factory-method route totality - a new product kind with no dispatch arm, caught as a dangling route on an unsampled kind
kata.series_report: docs/ref/pattern-kata-dispositions.md Factory Method row (disposed; construction dispatch); fixtures/katas/factory-method/README.md (pre-registered); beads catherine-r5k.2
kata.series_verdict: pre-registered: the route cell is null for the unsampled kind xml (row 2), an executed dangling finding; the sampled scripted test does not cover it, one unique element, scoped to exhaustive enumeration (coverage-only)

expected.detail: kind xml was added to the inventory with no arm: route(xml) is null. A creator with no default arm cannot construct it; the kernel emits an executed dangling route cell on the xml row. The baseline sample is {json, text}

commands: python3 prototype/factory_method_baseline.py --assert  # exit 0: baseline sample is {json, text}; no detection on xml
cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- check fixtures/katas/factory-method/dispatch.ct.json --json  # exit 0, findings []
cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- check fixtures/katas/factory-method/fault-missing-route.ct.json --json  # exit 4, 1 dangling

comparison.conventional_baseline: the scripted factory test over the pre-registered sample {json, text}: xml is unsampled, so the missing arm is never called and the test passes.

baseline.artifact: prototype/factory_method_baseline.py sha256:62553030b06c98d87d43bed081b1d857b2d41fb9d243d63bf17ee93e0cbf3848 (scripted sampled factory dispatch test; always executed before the probe arm)

expressibility_gap.invariant: route totality holds in the running creator
expressibility_gap.why: the fixture's route arrow is the transcription; a creator whose switch has a default arm never has a null arm, so this face applies only to a creator with no fallback (the fall-through face is the agreement entry)

procedure: 1. The law and the fault matrix were committed before the run; this entry tests the totality face on the unsampled kind xml.
2. The baseline arm (sha256 above) executed first over the frozen sample {json, text}; no detection.
3. The probe arm ran `catherine check --json` on the clean table (zero findings) and on the missing-arm variant (one dangling finding).
4. The dangling witness's source row (2) resolves to kind:xml over the declared alphabetical ProductKind rows; unique = {kind:xml}.
